personal.title: Planted clue
personal.description: Slip a napkin or beer mat with a scribbled "clue" (an arrow, a question mark, anything cryptic) onto someone's table without them noticing. Proof: your witness saw it land and watched them find it.

personal.title: The perfect alibi
personal.description: Get someone to say "I was in the library the whole time" in conversation. Proof: your witness heard them say it.

personal.title: Ransom note
personal.description: Swap someone's drink mat for one with a little "ransom note" scribbled on it. Proof: your witness saw the swap and the person's reaction.

personal.title: The butler did it
personal.description: Get the bartender to say "the butler did it", even as a joke. Proof: your witness heard them say it.

personal.title: Dusting for prints
personal.description: Ask a friend to hold a glass, then solemnly "dust" it with a pinch of napkin and declare the prints a match. Proof: your witness watched the whole performance.

personal.title: Suspicious whisper
personal.description: Whisper "they know" to someone, then walk off without explaining. Proof: your witness saw it, and the confused face afterwards.

personal.title: Moving the body
personal.description: Quietly relocate a small harmless object on a friend's table (a coaster, a menu, a salt shaker) to somewhere else on the table, and get away with it. Proof: your witness saw you do it and that nobody noticed.

personal.title: Fake confession
personal.description: Get someone to say "I confess" about something silly, like eating the last chip. Proof: your witness heard the confession.

personal.title: Red herring
personal.description: Casually mention a made-up suspect, such as "Sir Reginald", and get someone else to repeat the name. Proof: your witness heard them say it.

personal.title: Case closed
personal.description: Get the friends at your table to gasp dramatically when you announce "the murderer is in this room". Proof: your witness saw the gasps.

personal.title: The secret signal
personal.description: Agree a hidden gesture, such as tapping your ear, with a friend, then get them to use it three times. Proof: your witness spotted all three taps.

personal.title: The alias
personal.description: Introduce yourself to a friend of a friend using a murder-mystery alias and keep a straight face. Proof: your witness heard the alias and saw it go unquestioned.

personal.title: Stirring the evidence
personal.description: Dramatically examine a friend's empty crisp packet or peanut shell like a vital clue and place it in a napkin "evidence bag". Proof: your witness saw the bagging.

personal.title: Witness statement
personal.description: Get a friend to give you a formal "witness statement" about their evening in under one sentence. Proof: your witness heard the statement.

personal.title: The missing page
personal.description: Tear a corner from a beer mat, hand it to someone and say "you didn't get this from me". Proof: your witness saw you hand it over.

personal.title: Cryptic toast
personal.description: Propose a toast with a cryptic line like "to what the walls heard" and get the whole table to join in. Proof: your witness saw the group toast.

personal.title: Anonymous tip
personal.description: Write an "anonymous tip" on a napkin about another player and have it passed to them by a third person. Proof: your witness saw it handed over.

personal.title: The long stare
personal.description: Stare thoughtfully at a friend, say "interesting", and say nothing else until they ask what you mean. Proof: your witness heard them ask.

personal.title: Dropped evidence
personal.description: Leave a glove, scarf or other item of your own on a friend's chair and get them to hand it back to you while saying "this is evidence". Proof: your witness heard them say it.

personal.title: Taking notes
personal.description: Interview a friend with a straight face, writing their answers in a notebook or on your phone, until they start giving evasive answers. Proof: your witness saw the interview.

personal.title: Shocking revelation
personal.description: Announce a harmless "shocking revelation" about yourself, such as "I've never seen the last episode", and get a proper gasp. Proof: your witness heard the gasp.

personal.title: Rehearsed denial
personal.description: Get a friend to reply "I don't know what you're talking about" in a dramatic voice to a question you asked. Proof: your witness heard the denial.

personal.title: Chalk outline
personal.description: Arrange spilled crisps, sugar sachets or beer mats into the outline of a body on a table. Proof: your witness saw the finished arrangement.

personal.title: Mysterious handover
personal.description: Pass a friend a small object, such as a coin or a sugar packet, with a nod and "you know what to do". Proof: your witness saw the handover.

personal.title: Cover story
personal.description: Get someone to repeat back to you a cover story you made up, such as "we were at the opera all evening". Proof: your witness heard them repeat it.

personal.title: Weather of the crime
personal.description: Tell someone, deadpan, that it was a "dark and stormy night" and get them to agree. Proof: your witness heard the agreement.

personal.title: Evidence bag
personal.description: Persuade a friend to hand you a small personal item, like a sticker or a bottle cap, to be "logged as evidence" and give it back at the end. Proof: your witness saw it handed over and returned.

personal.title: Dramatic exit
personal.description: Leave the table with a long pause, a flourish, and the line "I have said too much". Proof: your witness saw the exit and heard the line.

global.title: Reconstruct the crime scene
global.description: Reconstruct the murder scene using only beer mats, glasses and whatever is on the table. Photo of the finished scene.

global.title: The usual suspects
global.description: Line up the whole group like a police line-up with numbers, scowls and one bold hat. Photo of the line-up.

global.title: Mugshots
global.description: Everyone takes a mugshot against a wall, holding a name card. Photo of the group's mugshots.

global.title: Body in the library
global.description: Stage a fake body on the floor, or a chair, with a suspicious bystander nearby. Photo of the scene.

global.title: Front page news
global.description: Pose as if for a newspaper front page about the murder, with a dramatic headline written on a napkin. Photo of the pose.

global.title: The secret society
global.description: Form a secret society handshake pose with the whole group. Photo of the pose.

global.title: Evidence table
global.description: Lay out the strangest five items from your pockets and bags as if they were evidence. Photo of the table.

global.title: The reveal
global.description: Stage the final drawing-room reveal, with one person pointing accusingly and the rest in shock. Photo of the tableau.

global.title: Family portrait
global.description: Recreate a stiff, Victorian-style family portrait of the Blackwood household. Photo of the portrait.

global.title: Suspicious selfie
global.description: Take a group selfie where every person looks guilty of something different. Photo of the selfie.
